statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that have persisted despite initial evaluation
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmia
CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring) was billed
Diagnosis codes R00.2 and R42 were submitted
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's symptoms and rule out or confirm an arrhythmia
